title: Create a poll and reach the owner view
description: This verifies that a creator can submit a valid poll and arrive at the poll page with owner controls available.

steps.description: Fill in the question field with a valid poll question
Fill in at least two answer option fields with unique options
Verify the poll page is displayed
Verify the owner management panel is visible

title: Create a poll and reach its voting page
description: This verifies that a new poll can be created from the landing page and that the user is taken to the poll page afterward.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Verify the user lands on a poll page
Verify the new poll is available for voting

title: Delete a poll with confirmation and return to the dashboard
description: This verifies that the owner can delete a poll after confirming the dialog and is returned to the polls dashboard.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Verify the user returns to the polls dashboard
Verify the deleted poll is no longer visible

title: Vote in a shared poll and see the result update
description: This verifies that a participant can cast a vote from a public poll page and see the results update afterward.

steps.description: Verify a vote confirmation is visible
Verify the results update is visible

title: Close and reopen a poll from the owner panel
description: This verifies that the owner can close a poll to stop voting and then reopen it to make voting available again.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Verify the poll is open for voting again
Verify the voting controls are available

title: Delete a poll after confirming the action
description: This verifies that an owner can delete a poll and is returned to the My polls dashboard afterward.

steps.description: Open an owned poll from the dashboard
Verify the My polls dashboard is displayed
Verify the deleted poll is no longer visible

title: Return to the same browser session and open My polls
description: This verifies that polls created in the current browser session appear on the My polls dashboard.

steps.description: Verify the current session's polls are displayed
Verify at least one owned poll card is visible

title: See owned polls and vote counts on the dashboard
description: This verifies that polls created in the current browser session appear on the My polls dashboard with their current vote counts.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Verify the created poll appears in the dashboard list
Verify the poll vote count is displayed

title: Copy the poll link from the owner panel
description: This verifies that the poll owner can copy the share link from the management panel after creating a poll.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Verify a copy confirmation is visible
Verify the poll sharing controls remain available

title: Prevent voting twice in the same browser session
description: This verifies that a participant cannot submit a second vote from the same browser session and sees an already voted message.

steps.description: Verify an already voted message is visible
Verify voting choices are no longer available

title: Prevent voting on a closed poll and allow voting after reopening
description: This verifies that a closed poll is read-only for voters and that reopening restores voting access.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Close the poll from the owner panel
Return to the poll voting view
Verify voting is disabled on the closed poll
Reopen the poll from the owner panel

title: Create a poll with no expiry
description: This verifies that a creator can choose no expiry and still successfully create a poll.

steps.description: Fill in the question field with a valid poll question
Fill in at least two answer option fields with unique options
Verify the poll page is displayed
Verify the poll is open for voting

title: Create a poll and share it from the owner panel
description: This verifies that after creating a poll the owner can access sharing controls from the poll page.

steps.description: Fill in the question field with a valid poll question
Fill in at least two answer option fields with unique options
Open the sharing controls in the owner panel
Verify a share link can be accessed

title: Share a poll by email from the owner panel
description: This verifies that the owner can initiate email sharing for a created poll from the management panel.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Start sharing the poll by email
Verify the email share controls are displayed
Verify the poll remains accessible from the owner panel

title: Open an existing poll from My polls to manage it
description: This verifies that a poll card on the dashboard opens the full management view for that poll.

steps.description: Verify the poll page is displayed
Verify the owner management panel is visible

title: View the poll QR code from the owner panel
description: This verifies that the owner can open the poll QR code in the management panel for sharing.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Open the poll QR code view
Verify the QR code is displayed
Verify the poll sharing panel remains visible

title: Open an existing poll from the dashboard
description: This verifies that a poll card in the dashboard opens the poll details and management view for a session-owned poll.

steps.description: Add at least two poll options
Verify the poll page is displayed
Verify the owner management panel is available

title: Add and remove answer options before creating a poll
description: This verifies that a creator can adjust the option count during poll setup and still create a valid poll.

steps.description: Fill in the question field with a valid poll question
Fill in two answer option fields with unique options
Verify the poll page is displayed
Verify the poll owner controls are visible

title: Create a poll and open QR and email share options
description: This verifies that the owner panel exposes QR code and email sharing controls after poll creation.

steps.description: Fill in the question field with a valid poll question
Fill in at least two answer option fields with unique options
Open the sharing controls in the owner panel
Expand the QR code sharing option
Verify the QR code sharing content is visible
Verify the email sharing control is visible

title: Use the new poll entry point from an empty dashboard
description: This verifies that a first-time visitor sees the empty dashboard state and can start creating a poll from there.

steps.description: Verify an empty state message is visible
Verify the poll creation form is displayed

title: Prevent creating a poll without a question
description: This verifies that submitting an empty question is blocked and a validation toast is shown.

steps.description: Fill in at least two answer option fields with unique options
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the poll page is not displayed

title: Prevent creating a poll with invalid options
description: This verifies that duplicate or empty answer options are rejected during poll creation.

steps.description: Fill in the question field with a valid poll question
Fill in one empty answer option and one duplicate answer option
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the poll page is not displayed

title: View a closed poll as read-only
description: This verifies that a closed poll no longer allows voting and is shown in a read-only state.

steps.description: Return to the public poll view
Verify the poll is shown as closed
